svg.title: nODD tracker, solenoid, restored LAr ECAL and DES046 HCAL, R-Z
svg.desc: Composite envelope/sampling-stack schematic. Tracker sensitive group bounds; ECAL warm and sampling bounds; conditional solenoid allocations; isolated validated HCAL prototype. Polygon radii are face apothems. Individual module/sector gaps and tracker passives are unresolved in this view. No common native detector, installed field or engineering acceptance. FCAL and muons omitted.
svg.text: Current selected LAr ECAL and DES043 tracker • 60-layer HCAL with DES046 edge modules • 20 November 2026
Equal r–z scale • envelope and sampling-stack schematic • DRAFT / PROTOTYPE
30 mm steel + 12 mm cassette + 1 mm allowance
Polygon radii are face apothems; barrel corner reaches R 5.832 m. Steel: light orange; readout cassettes: dark orange.
ECAL: pale yellow = warm package; yellow = sampling. Solenoid: hatched vessel, grey cold-mass allocation, dashed reservation.
DES046 narrows the barrel edge modules to leave 7.05 mm per side at the core plane; the global r–z outline is unchanged.
Tracker: 46,682 sensitive planes; passive services and individual calorimeter module/sector gaps are unresolved here.
Composite view, not a common native detector. Installed magnet, support/services qualification, FCAL and muon integration remain open.
